# `vox-lsp`

**Crate:** `vox-lsp` · **Version:** `0.6.0` · **Target:** Library (`lib.rs`)

Vox Language Server Protocol implementation (stdio JSON-RPC).

## Crate Overview

Language Server Protocol integration for Vox.

Shared validation helpers used by the LSP binary and MCP / orchestrator quality gates.

### Functions

| Function | Description |
|---|---|
| `byte_index_to_line_col` | Convert UTF-8 byte index to LSP line / column (character count per line, not UTF-16 code units). |
| `validate_document` | Run lexer → parser → typecheck and return LSP diagnostics (no side effects).  Note: This does **not** run HIR structural validation. For parity with the CLI frontend (`run_frontend_str`), use [`validate_document_with_hir`]. |
| `validate_document_with_hir` | Full frontend validation: lexer → parser → typecheck → HIR lower → HIR validate.  Matches the diagnostic shape produced by `vox-cli` `run_frontend_str` for type/HIR issues (parse errors are always surfaced as errors). |
| `quickfixes_for_diagnostics` | Build quick-fix [`CodeAction`]s from diagnostics that carry structured `data.fixes` (parity with the stdio LSP `textDocument/codeAction` handler). |
| `word_at_position` | Word at LSP `(line, character)` using **0-based** lines and **character = column in Unicode scalars** (same convention as [`byte_index_to_line_col`]). |
| `line_has_speech_transcribe` | True if `line` contains a `Speech.transcribe` / `Speech . transcribe` call (word boundaries). |
| `builtin_hover_markdown_in_line` | Markdown hover using the **current line** so `transcribe` only hovers in `Speech.transcribe` context. |
| `builtin_hover_markdown` | Short markdown hovers for selected builtins (Oratio, HTTP, stdlib). |
